headline: Google limits free Gemini access to its weakest model
summary: Google is removing free access to its Gemini Flash and Pro AI models on October 9, with zdnet reporting that even AI Plus subscribers will also lose access to those models.

claims.statement: Free Gemini users will lose access to Google's Flash and Pro AI models starting October 9.

sources.quote: Google removes free access to Gemini Flash and Pro on October 9
Google is cutting off free users from the Flash and Pro models.

claims.statement: AI Plus subscribers will also lose access to the Flash and Pro models, not just free users.

sources.quote: AI Plus subscribers are losing out too

discrepancies.explanation: zdnet reports that AI Plus subscribers are also losing access, a detail engadget's text does not mention.

quotes.quote: AI Plus subscribers are losing out too
Free Gemini users are losing access to Google's Flash and Pro AI models.
